scope: BOK Park Plaza facade reconstruction and source-shape correction; existing source snapshots are retained.

building.name: BOK Park Plaza / 499 Sheridan
building.facadeType: Reflective curtain wall with physically projecting vertical rods above the lobby

supports: relation to Devon campus and Myriad Gardens

verticalRods.basis: Architect describes vertical curtain-wall rods. Spacing follows the existing 14.4-meter facade tile divided into 12 panes; dimensions and exact endpoints are an authored reconstruction, not measured construction details.

reconstruction.method: The 35-foot lobby and 40-foot crown bound 26 equally spaced reconstructed office floors inside the retained 132-meter mapped height.
limitations: Intermediate floor elevations and pane spacing are not surveyed.
The vertical rods are modeled as narrow rectangular fins; exact rod section, projection, connections and spacing are not surveyed.
Coating reflectance is a visual approximation, not measured product data.
Office lighting is procedural occupancy, not a survey of tenants.
The crown is not artificially illuminated by this material.
